displayName: OCI-AI-GOV-013: AI — Audit Trail Gap Detection
description:
Detects gaps in AI system audit trails that violate governance record-keeping requirements

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_gov_013", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%audit%' AND "value" > 0
